snippet.title: Developer Log — College Architect (Episode 3)
snippet.description:
This is the third time we have showcased Collegeria (now College Architect). Let's just say, a lot has changed since the last time we showcased it.

Since then, we have published our store page, and it is now available to wishlist.

Wishlist College Architect on Steam ➤ https://store.steampowered.com/app/5006550/College_Architect/
